```{r}
library(ggplot2)

plot_counts <- function(data, category_col, colour_col,
                        position = "stack") {

  ggplot(
    data,
    aes(
      x = factor(.data[[category_col]]),
      fill = .data[[colour_col]]
    )
  ) +
    geom_bar(position = position) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Counts of", category_col, "by", colour_col),
      x = category_col,
      y = "Count",
      fill = colour_col
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
}
```

```{r}
p1 <- plot_counts(Nepal_clusters, "GPSC", "VT")
p1
p2 <- plot_counts(Nepal_clusters, "Serotype", "VT")
p2
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

plot_freq_compare <- function(dfs, col,
                              df_names = NULL,
                              colors = NULL,
                              position = "dodge",
                              min_freq = 0.01,
                              sort_by_df = 3) {

  if (is.null(df_names)) {
    df_names <- paste0("df", seq_along(dfs))
  }

  if (length(df_names) != length(dfs)) {
    stop("df_names must have the same length as dfs")
  }

  # Default colors if none provided
  if (is.null(colors)) {
    colors <- scales::hue_pal()(length(dfs))
  }

  if (length(colors) != length(dfs)) {
    stop("colors must have the same length as dfs")
  }

  # All values across datasets
  all_values <- sort(unique(unlist(lapply(dfs, function(d) d[[col]]))))

  # Build summary dataframe
  summary_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(dfs), function(i) {

    d <- dfs[[i]]
    n <- nrow(d)

    tab <- table(factor(d[[col]], levels = all_values))

    data.frame(
      value = names(tab),
      frequency = as.numeric(tab) / n,
      dataframe = df_names[i],
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }))

  # Filter low-frequency categories
  max_freq_by_value <- aggregate(frequency ~ value,
                                 data = summary_df,
                                 FUN = max)

  keep_values <- max_freq_by_value$value[
    max_freq_by_value$frequency > min_freq
  ]

  summary_df <- subset(summary_df, value %in% keep_values)
  summary_df$dataframe <- factor(summary_df$dataframe, levels = df_names)
  colors <- setNames(colors, df_names)

  # Sort x-axis by selected dataframe
  ref_df_name <- df_names[sort_by_df]

  ordering <- subset(summary_df, dataframe == ref_df_name)
  ordering <- ordering[order(-ordering$frequency), ]

  ordered_values <- ordering$value

  summary_df$value <- factor(summary_df$value,
                             levels = ordered_values)

  ggplot(summary_df,
         aes(x = value,
             y = frequency,
             fill = dataframe)) +
    geom_col(position = position) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
    labs(
      x = col,
      y = "Frequency",
      fill = "Dataframe"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
  axis.text = element_text(size = 14),      # tick labels
  axis.title = element_text(size = 16),     # axis names
  legend.text = element_text(size = 14),    # legend labels
  legend.title = element_text(size = 16)    # legend title
)
}
```

```{r}
plot_freq_compare(list(Nepal_clusters, UK_clusters, US_clusters), "GPSC", df_names = c("Kathmandu", "Southampton", "Massachusetts"), colors = c("black", "#56B4E9", "#D55E00"))
plot_freq_compare(list(Nepal_clusters, UK_clusters, US_clusters), "Serotype", df_names = c("Kathmandu", "Southampton", "Massachusetts"), colors = c("black", "#56B4E9", "#D55E00"))

```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

plot_three_ordered_by_df3 <- function(dfs, col, df_names = NULL, colors = NULL, min_freq = 0.01) {
  if (length(dfs) != 3) stop("Please provide exactly 3 dataframes.")
  
  if (is.null(df_names)) {
    df_names <- paste0("df", seq_along(dfs))
  }
  if (length(df_names) != 3) stop("df_names must have length 3.")
  
  if (is.null(colors)) {
    colors <- c("tomato", "steelblue", "darkgreen")
  }
  if (length(colors) != 3) stop("colors must have length 3.")
  names(colors) <- df_names
  
  # All values seen in any dataframe
  all_values <- sort(unique(unlist(lapply(dfs, function(d) d[[col]]))))
  
  # Frequencies for each dataframe
  freq_df <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_along(dfs), function(i) {
    d <- dfs[[i]]
    tab <- table(factor(d[[col]], levels = all_values))
    data.frame(
      value = names(tab),
      frequency = as.numeric(tab) / nrow(d),
      dataframe = df_names[i],
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }))
  
  # Keep values that appear above threshold in at least one dataframe
  keep_values <- freq_df %>%
    group_by(value) %>%
    summarise(max_freq = max(frequency), .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(max_freq > min_freq) %>%
    pull(value)
  
  freq_df <- freq_df %>%
    filter(value %in% keep_values)
  
  # Order by frequencies in the 3rd dataframe
  order_values <- freq_df %>%
    filter(dataframe == df_names[3]) %>%
    arrange(desc(frequency), value) %>%
    pull(value)
  
  # Add any values missing from df3 at the end
  order_values <- c(order_values, setdiff(unique(freq_df$value), order_values))
  
  make_plot <- function(df_name) {
    plot_data <- freq_df %>%
      filter(dataframe == df_name) %>%
      mutate(value = factor(value, levels = order_values))
    
    ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = value, y = frequency, fill = dataframe)) +
      geom_col(width = 0.8) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = colors, guide = "none") +
      labs(
        title = df_name,
        x = col,
        y = "Frequency"
      ) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
      )
  }
  
  list(
    plot1 = make_plot(df_names[1]),
    plot2 = make_plot(df_names[2]),
    plot3 = make_plot(df_names[3])
  )
}
```

```{r}
p <- plot_three_ordered_by_df3(list(Nepal_clusters, UK_clusters, US_clusters), "GPSC", df_names = c("Kathmandu", "Southampton", "Massachusetts"), colors = c("black", "#56B4E9", "#D55E00"))
p

p2 <- plot_three_ordered_by_df3(list(Nepal_clusters, UK_clusters, US_clusters), "Serotype", df_names = c("Kathmandu", "Southampton", "Massachusetts"), colors = c("black", "#56B4E9", "#D55E00"))
p2
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

plot_binned_freqs <- function(v1, v2, v3,
                              names = c("V1", "V2", "V3"),
                              colors = c("tomato", "steelblue", "darkgreen"),
                              bin_width1 = 0.1,
                              xlim = c(0, 1)) {

  if (length(names) != 3) stop("names must have length 3")
  if (length(colors) != 3) stop("colors must have length 3")
  names(colors) <- names

  breaks <- seq(xlim[1], xlim[2], by = bin_width1)

  bin_counts <- function(v, label, bin_width = bin_width1, xmax = 1) {

  v <- v[v > 0]

  breaks <- seq(0, xmax, by = bin_width)

  h <- hist(v, breaks = breaks, plot = FALSE)

  data.frame(
    bin_center = h$mids,
    count = h$counts,
    series = label
  )
  }
  
  d1 <- bin_counts(v1, names[1])
  d2 <- bin_counts(v2, names[2])
  d3 <- bin_counts(v3, names[3])

  make_plot <- function(dat, label) {
    ggplot(dat, aes(x = bin_center, y = count, fill = series)) +
  geom_col(width = bin_width1 * 0.9) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors, guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = label,
    x = "Frequency",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 18)
  }

  list(
    plot1 = make_plot(d1, names[1]),
    plot2 = make_plot(d2, names[2]),
    plot3 = make_plot(d3, names[3])
  )
}
```

```{r}
plots <- plot_binned_freqs(
  Nepal_gene_freqs, UK_gene_freqs, US_gene_freqs, bin_width = 0.02,
  names = c("Kathmandu", "Southampton", "Massachusetts"), colors = c("black", "#56B4E9", "#D55E00")
)
plots
```
